error.no_devices_found: Connected to the gateway, but it did not report any air conditioners.

data_description.gateway_address: The address the gateway itself answers to, which is 1 from the factory. Change this only if the gateway was set to another address.
data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the ZhongHong gateway on your network.
data_description.port: The port the gateway accepts connections on. This is 9999 unless it was changed on the gateway.

cannot_connect.message: Failed to connect to the ZhongHong gateway at {host}.

no_devices_found.message: The ZhongHong gateway at {host} did not report any air conditioners.

send_command_failed.message: Failed to send {command} command to the ZhongHong gateway.
